acknowledge-button.alt: Select the Acknowledge button to indicate that you've read it and taken necessary action.

add-user-icon.alt: Account plus outline icon used to add user to a channel.

ai-actions-icon.alt: Select the AI Actions icon to access AI options.

attachments-icon.alt: Add a message attachment using the Upload files icon in the message formatting toolbar.

away.alt: Away availability status icon in Mattermost.

bold-icon.alt: Bold message text using the Bold icon in the message formatting toolbar.

bullets-icon.alt: Format message text as a bulleted list using the Bulleted list icon in the message formatting toolbar.

channel-files-icon.alt: Use the Channel Files icon to search for files attached to messages in a given channel.

channel-info.alt: Use the Channel Info icon to access additional channel management options.

checkmark.alt: Green checkmark icon used to indicate that a given feature is included in a specific package, deployment, or plan.

code-icon.alt: Format message text as code using the Code icon in the message formatting toolbar.

copy-link-icon.alt: Use the Copy Link icon to copy the public URL link for an image in a message.

desktop-download-icon.alt: Use the desktop app download icon to review download status, as well as access and clear the list of downloaded files.

dnd.alt: Do Not Disturb availability status icon in Mattermost.

download-icon.alt: Use the Download icon to download an attached file to your local system.

edit-on-github.alt: Contribute to Mattermost documentation by selecting the Edit option located in the top right corner of any documentation page.

emoji-icon.alt: Add emojis or GIFs to message text using the Emoji/Gif picker icon in the message formatting toolbar.

favorite-icon.alt: Use the Star icon to mark a channel as a favorite.

file-box.alt: Archived channels are identified with a File Box icon.

gear.alt: Use the Settings icon to customize your Mattermost user experience.

globe.alt: Public channels are identified with a Globe icon.

headings-icon.alt: Format message text as a heading using the Heading icon in the message formatting toolbar. Headings 1 through 6 are supported.

hide-formatting-icon.alt: Hide formatting options in the message formatting toolbar using the Show/Hide Formatting icon.

italics-icon.alt: Italicize message text using the Italic icon in the message formatting toolbar.

lock.alt: Private channels are identified with a Lock icon.

message-priority-icon.alt: Mark a message as important or urgent using the Priority Message icon.

more-icon.alt: Use the More icon to access additional message options.

more-icon-vertical.alt: Use the More icon in the top left corner to access Mattermost desktop apps customization settings.

new-window-icon.alt: Open thread in a new browser window icon.

numbered-icon.alt: Format message text as a numbered list using the Numbered list icon in the message formatting toolbar.

offline.alt: Offline availability status icon in Mattermost.

online.alt: Online availability status icon in Mattermost.

pinned-messages.alt: Pin icon used to indicate when there are pinned messages in a given channel.

plus.alt: The Plus icon provides access to channel and direct message functionality.

preview-icon.alt: Review your message text formatting using the Show/Hide preview icon in the message formatting toolbar.

product-list.alt: Navigate between Channels, collaborative playbooks, and boards using the product menu icon.

quotes-icon.alt: Format message text as a quotation using the Quote icon in the message formatting toolbar.

restore-edit.alt: Use the Restore icon to restore a previous version of an edited message.

search-icon.alt: Search for messages and files in Mattermost.

send-icon.alt: Select the Send icon to post your message.

servers-icon.alt: Access server connection options using the Servers icon.

shared.alt: Shared icon indicates channels and their members that are shared across connected Mattermost servers.

smile-icon.alt: Use the Smile icon to add emojis to your message.

strikeout-icon.alt: Strike out message text using the Strikethrough icon in the message formatting toolbar.
